cards.title: The Exoneration
cards.subtitle: DNA testing proved he was innocent all along

ctaLine: Follow Cold Trail for cases the mainstream forgot
voiceover:
In July nineteen eighty four, nine year old Dawn Hamilton was found dead in a wooded area near Baltimore. She had been sexually assaulted and beaten.

Kirk Bloodsworth, a former Marine with no criminal record, was arrested after five witnesses identified him from a composite sketch.

No physical evidence connected him to the crime. He was convicted on eyewitness testimony alone and sentenced to death.

In nineteen ninety three, newly available DNA testing excluded Bloodsworth completely. He became the first death row inmate exonerated by DNA evidence.

He served nine years for a murder he didn't commit. The real killer was identified in two thousand three through DNA.

Follow Cold Trail for cases the mainstream forgot.
